_meta.description: Example configuration for the FTMO 2-Step Swing prototype. Every field marked UNVERIFIED must be confirmed against the live terminal / broker / FTMO agreement before this config is used for anything beyond EXPLORATORY offline research.

account._comment_account_number_server_name: Must be filled from the live terminal (AccountNumber()/AccountServer()) before any live/demo run. Used as the instance/state binding guard.

ftmo_limits._comment: FTMO 2-Step Swing published limits as of the 2026-09-17 conversation. Re-verify against the current FTMO agreement before operational use (see docs/UNKNOWNS.md).

robot_limits._comment: Robot works to a tighter (more conservative) limit than the raw FTMO limit. Applicable floor = max(balance_at_midnight - 300, 9200).

risk._comment_execution_buffer: Hypothetical safety margin subtracted in the pre-trade worst-case projection to absorb slippage/spread widening not otherwise modeled. Not an FTMO requirement -- a prototype design choice.

server_time_model._comment: CONFIRMED 2026-09-18 by the account owner: FTMO's MT4 server runs GMT+2 (winter/standard) / GMT+3 (summer/DST), transitioning on the same dates as the EU. 'Europe/Bucharest' is used purely as the zoneinfo database entry with that exact GMT+2/+3-with-EU-DST pattern -- it is not a claim that the broker is physically in Romania.

costs._comment_commission: CONFIRMED 2026-09-18 by the account owner: FTMO's forex/exotics commission is 2.50 USD per lot per side, i.e. 5.00 USD total per round-turn lot. This field is the round-turn total.
costs._comment_spread: Spread is floating per the instrument specification screenshot; no historical spread feed was supplied. This fixed-point value is a labeled EXPLORATORY placeholder only.

strategies._comment_active: CHOSEN 2026-09-18 by the account owner ('turpinam to strategiju ar kuru ir lielaka pelna'): of the three strategies compared in reports/run_003_strategy_comparison/, EMA(20/50) H1 crossover had the smallest loss (-257.98 USD) on the only available ~2-month sample. No further historical data will be supplied, so this choice cannot be re-validated against a fresh out-of-sample window -- see docs/UNKNOWNS.md and README.md for why 'least-bad of three on one short sample' is not the same claim as 'validated' or 'expected profitable'.

london_breakout_retest_v1._comment: Fixed baseline (spec section 7). Kept as reference / the first attempt; not the active strategy going forward.

ema_cross_v1._comment: Standard textbook parameters, not tuned to this sample. Holds positions overnight/across the 16:00 London boundary by design (a swing-style trend-follower).

donchian_v1._comment: S6, docs/EXPERIMENT_PLAN_2026-09-18.md section 2. Parameters taken directly from the task instructions, not fitted. No fixed TP; exits on the 10-bar-extreme crossing or the ATR stop only.
